China criticizes Japan's defense paper labeling it a strategic challenge

China has criticized Japan's latest defense white paper, which labels China as the "greatest strategic challenge." Chinese officials stated that Japan's move is a "serious violation" of the principles of the China-Japan joint statement and a "deliberate distortion" of China's defense policy. They also accused Japan of hyping regional threats and seeking to militarize itself. China urged Japan to adhere to its pacifist constitution and stop actions that undermine regional peace and stability.
